description: A subset closed under all selected witness functions is closed under every original interpreted function, including constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.selectedWitnesses_fun_closed.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (m : M) (X : Set M)
  (hX :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty (n + 1)) (a : Fin n → M),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), a i ∈ X) → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.selectedWitness m φ a ∈ X)
  {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n) (a : Fin n → M) (ha : ∀ (i : Fin n), a i ∈ X) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap f a ∈ X
